procedural_matters: ITA 36342 was represented by Cosimo D’Incecco.
ESP 36388 was represented by Tomas Budino.
Marco Crecchi (ITA 3) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: Conditions during the Vaurien race 2 were 20 knots of wind and 0,9 m waves.
On the first beat to windward, ITA 3 sailing on close-hauled starboard tack.
ESP 36388 and ITA 36342 sailing on a close-hauled port tack overlapped, with ITA 36342 one boat width to leeward of ESP 36388, both boats on a converging course with ITA 3.
Two boat lengths from ITA 3, ITA 36342 hailed ’’Room to tack’’.
ESP 36388 did not change course nor responded.
One meter from ITA 3, ITA 36342 luffed.
At the same time ITA 3 luffed head to wind.
Then ITA 36342 passed head to wind and bore away and capsized.
ESP 36388 did not change course and passed 2-3 m in front of ITA 3.
conclusions: ESP 36388 failed to tack as soon as possible and did not respond immediately after ITA 36342 hailed "Room to tack" and broke RRS 20.2(b) and (c).
ITA 36342 failed to give ESP 36388 time to respond after she hailed "Room to tack", and broke RRS 20.2(a).
ITA 36342 on port tack failed to keep clear of ITA 3 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
decision: ESP 36388 and ITA 36342 are DSQ from race 2.
